verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented pricing model, so predictability is only implied. Meilisearch ships as a dependency-free self-hostable binary, and self-hosters report flat, modest hardware costs at scale: 1M records on an $8/mo Hetzner box, and ~80M documents on a single 64GB server. Against that, one user hit a jump from the free cloud tier to a $1200/month plan, and another team found RAM needs under heavy search traffic too unpredictable and expensive to plan. Missing for 10: documented cloud pricing structure (per-record vs per-request vs resource-based), explicit no-overage/no-per-request-cliff guarantees, smooth intermediate tiers, predictable resource sizing guidance under query load.
